name: io.github.nirholas/knock-mcp
title: three.ws Knock
description: Reach a real person: quote their door, browse who is reachable, knock, and read the reply.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) or OAuth access token. Optional: needed only for knock_inbox and knock_act, which manage your own door. Quoting, browsing, knocking and reading a receipt all work without it. Treat like a password.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.
